# Translation files

## `translation/_AutoGeneratedTranslations.txt` -> `BepInEx/Translation/en/Text/`
One entry per line: `原文=English`.
* Escape in both sides: `\` -> `\\`, `=` -> `\=`, newline -> `\n`, CR -> `\r`. Strip leading/trailing whitespace.
* Keep `<color=#...>`, `<size=..>`, `{0}`, `%d` exactly as in the source.
* Regex lines (verbatim, not escaped) at the end of the file:
  ```
  r:"^存档([0-9]+)$"=Save $1
  sr:"^第(?<n_i>[0-9]+)天\s*(?<rest>[\s\S]*)$"="Day ${n_i} ${rest}"
  ```
  Current rule list: `tools/regex.txt` (day N, weekday + (Workday), `name xN`, `name Lv.N`, save slots, dates,
  Yuan amounts incl. decimals, July-1 countdown, cooldown, daily limit, original price, levels/stars/floors/multipliers).
* ~7,800 pairs. Built by `tools/build.py` (first 5,084), `tools/build2.py` (+2,387), `tools/build3.py` (+323 chat, regex, emit).

## `translation/_AutoGeneratedresizer.txt`
`/UI_Select(Clone)=ChangeFontSizeByPercentage(0.6)` for ~46 UI roots, each with and without `(Clone)`.
To add a root: turn on `EnableTextPathLogging=True`, open the screen, read `Path : /Root(Clone)/...` in `LogOutput.log`,
add `/Root` and `/Root(Clone)`.

## `translation/AutoTranslatorConfig.ini`
Key settings: `Endpoint=` (empty), `Language=en`, `FromLanguage=zh`, `EnableUIResizing=True`,
texture options all `False`, `EnableTextPathLogging=False` (turn on only for debugging).

## Glossary / style decisions
| Chinese | English | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 元神 | Soul | collectible companions ("Soul Secret Realm", "SR/SSR Soul") |
| 帮会 / 会长 | Guild / Guild Leader | |
| 皇城 / 城主 | Imperial City / Lord (Imperial City Lord) | |
| 副本 / 秘境 | Dungeon / Secret Realm | |
| 氪金 / 氪佬 | Pay-to-Win / Whale | "氪" in names -> "Kr-" puns (Kroe, Krebird) |
| 天命人 | Destined One | Black Myth reference |
| 传说 / 传奇 | Mythic / Legendary | 传说 = Mythic (top), 传奇 = Legendary |
| 肝 | Grind / Liver (context: 肝悦 = Gan Yue) | health bar uses Liver |
| 元 | Yuan | amounts are kept in Yuan, no conversion |
| 国产网游 | Domestic Online Game | title 中国式网游 = Chinese-Style Online Game |
| 蛛厂/蛾厂/鹅厂/猪厂 | Spider/Moth/Goose/Pig Factory | company parodies |
| 麦烧基 | McBurger | KFC/McDonald's parody; 并歹歹 = Bing Dai Dai (Pinduoduo parody) |
| 保底 | Pity (hard pity) | gacha |
| 阿米诺斯 | Aminos | meme word, left as is |
Slang/insults are translated at roughly the same strength; profanity is softened only when it is pure filler.
